check.name: Stable version
check.comment: Checks if the object is using a deprecated apiVersion

check.name: Label values
check.comment: Validates label values

check.name: Pod Probes Identical
check.comment: Container has the same readiness and liveness probe

check.name: Pod Topology Spread Constraints
check.comment: Pod Topology Spread Constraints

comments.description: No Pod Topology Spread Constraints set, kube-scheduler defaults assumed

check.name: Container Image Tag
check.comment: Makes sure that a explicit non-latest tag is used

comments.description: Using a fixed tag is recommended to avoid accidental upgrades

check.name: Container Image Pull Policy
check.comment: Makes sure that the pullPolicy is set to Always. This makes sure that imagePullSecrets are always validated.

check.name: Container Ephemeral Storage Request Equals Limit
check.comment: Make sure all pods have matching ephemeral-storage requests and limits

check.name: Environment Variable Key Duplication
check.comment: Makes sure that duplicated environment variable keys are not duplicated

check.name: Pod NetworkPolicy
check.comment: Makes sure that all Pods are targeted by a NetworkPolicy

comments.summary: The pod does not have a matching NetworkPolicy
comments.description: Create a NetworkPolicy that targets this pod to control who/what can communicate with this pod. Note, this feature needs to be supported by the CNI implementation used in the Kubernetes cluster to have an effect.

check.name: Pod Probes
check.comment: Makes sure that all Pods have safe probe configurations

check.name: Container Resource Requests Equal Limits
check.comment: Makes sure that all pods have the same requests as limits on resources set.

check.name: Container Memory Requests Equal Limits
check.comment: Makes sure that all pods have the same memory requests as limits set.

check.name: Container Ports Check
check.comment: Container Ports Checks

check.name: Container Seccomp Profile
check.comment: Makes sure that all pods have at a seccomp policy configured.

check.name: Container Resources
check.comment: Makes sure that all pods have resource limits and requests set. The --ignore-container-cpu-limit flag can be used to disable the requirement of having a CPU limit

check.name: Container CPU Requests Equal Limits
check.comment: Makes sure that all pods have the same CPU requests as limits set.

check.name: Container Security Context User Group ID
check.comment: Makes sure that all pods have a security context with valid UID and GID set

comments.summary: The container is running with a low user ID
comments.description: A userid above 10 000 is recommended to avoid conflicts with the host. Set securityContext.runAsUser to a value > 10000

comments.summary: The container running with a low group ID
comments.description: A groupid above 10 000 is recommended to avoid conflicts with the host. Set securityContext.runAsGroup to a value > 10000

check.name: Container Security Context ReadOnlyRootFilesystem
check.comment: Makes sure that all pods have a security context with read only filesystem set

comments.summary: The pod has a container with a writable root filesystem

check.name: Container Ephemeral Storage Request and Limit
check.comment: Makes sure all pods have ephemeral-storage requests and limits set

comments.summary: Ephemeral Storage limit is not set
comments.description: Resource limits are recommended to avoid resource DDOS. Set resources.limits.ephemeral-storage

comments.summary: Ephemeral Storage request is not set
comments.description: Resource requests are recommended to make sure the application can start and run without crashing. Set resource.requests.ephemeral-storage

check.name: Container Security Context Privileged
check.comment: Makes sure that all pods have a unprivileged security context set

comments.description: Set securityContext.privileged to false. Privileged containers can access all devices on the host, and grants almost the same access as non-containerized processes on the host.

check.name: Deployment has host PodAntiAffinity
check.comment: Makes sure that a podAntiAffinity has been set that prevents multiple pods from being scheduled on the same node. https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/assign-pod-node/

comments.summary: Deployment does not have a host podAntiAffinity set
comments.description: It's recommended to set a podAntiAffinity that stops multiple pods from a deployment from being scheduled on the same node. This increases availability in case the node becomes unavailable.

check.name: Deployment targeted by HPA does not have replicas configured
check.comment: Makes sure that Deployments using a HorizontalPodAutoscaler doesn't have a statically configured replica count set

comments.summary: Skipped because the deployment is not targeted by a HorizontalPodAutoscaler

check.name: Deployment Pod Selector labels match template metadata labels
check.comment: Ensure the StatefulSet selector labels match the template metadata labels.

check.name: Deployment Strategy
check.comment: Makes sure that all Deployments targeted by service use RollingUpdate strategy

check.name: Deployment Replicas
check.comment: Makes sure that Deployment has multiple replicas

check.name: Deployment has PodDisruptionBudget
check.comment: Makes sure that all Deployments are targeted by a PDB

comments.description: It's recommended to define a PodDisruptionBudget to avoid unexpected downtime during Kubernetes maintenance operations, such as when draining a node.

check.name: Stable version
check.comment: Checks if the object is using a deprecated apiVersion

check.name: Label values
check.comment: Validates label values

check.name: Service Targets Pod
check.comment: Makes sure that all Services targets a Pod

check.name: Service Type
check.comment: Makes sure that the Service type is not NodePort

results.description: Bucket does not encrypt data with a customer managed key.
